project.name: hetu
project.description: HETU is a local-first GATE preparation system that turns timed question practice into immutable attempt evidence, mistake diagnosis, spaced re-attempts, adaptive planning, readiness and rank signals, and focused buddy study.

nodes.name: Learner Access and Account Security
nodes.summary: This domain controls HETU's invite-only learner onboarding, username/PIN authentication, account recovery, and owner-reviewed access queue. It also establishes the authenticated user boundary that scopes local and remote study data and prevents account enumeration or cross-user residue.

businessRules: Accounts can only be created from an approved, unexpired invite bound to the requester's identity.
Username and PIN failures must use uniform responses so account existence is not disclosed.
Every persisted learner record is scoped to the authenticated user, and sign-out wipes account-sensitive local state.
crossDomainInteractions: Supplies the learner identity used to scope study, planner, PYQ, readiness, notification, and buddy records.
Owner decisions trigger transactional email and invitation delivery in the engagement domain.

nodes.name: Focused Study and Question Analysis
nodes.summary: This domain runs the core solve, time, tag, log, journal, and review lifecycle for individual questions and focused sessions. It converts raw practice into structured evidence about outcomes, recurring patterns, trigger phrases, root causes, timing, and concrete weekly corrections.

businessRules: A question can be saved locally while offline and must retain its user, session, timing, and analysis evidence.
Non-clean outcomes can create spaced re-attempt work, while clean outcomes do not.
Deleting a session must preserve its questions as standalone evidence rather than deleting learner history.
crossDomainInteractions: Receives immutable PYQ receipts for deeper journal analysis.
Feeds mistakes, patterns, timing, and weekly fixes into spaced mastery, planning, and readiness calculations.

nodes.name: PYQ Practice and Attempt Integrity
nodes.summary: This domain builds and serves HETU's audited GATE-level previous-year-question catalog and runs book-aware, timed practice sets. It preserves every committed answer as an immutable, versioned receipt containing the presented question snapshot, answer, decision, timing, session, and source identity.

businessRules: Only allowlisted GATE-level source books with locked counts, stable IDs, and audited taxonomy may enter the catalog.
Committed answers are immutable and retries must reuse deterministic attempt identifiers.
A receipt must preserve the exact question and book identity so later bank changes cannot rewrite history.
crossDomainInteractions: Creates canonical journal questions for focused analysis without losing the source attempt receipt.
Incorrect, uncertain, slow, or skipped attempts can enter the spaced re-attempt ladder.
Attempt history contributes to topic mastery, readiness, and prioritized daily work.

nodes.name: Spaced Mastery and Revision
nodes.summary: This domain turns diagnosed weaknesses into retrieval practice through the D3-D10-D30 re-attempt ladder, formula recall, trigger drills, and focused revision packs. It keeps answer evidence concealed during recall, advances only on successful retrieval, and prioritizes unresolved work over passive review.

businessRules: Eligible mistakes begin at D3 and advance through D10 and D30 only after a clean result.
There may be only one open re-attempt for the same question at a time.
Recall surfaces keep saved answers hidden until the learner explicitly reveals or submits an answer.
crossDomainInteractions: Consumes outcomes and attempt receipts from question analysis and PYQ practice.
Supplies due work, retention evidence, and open mistake surface to planning, notifications, and readiness.

nodes.name: Study Planning, Progress, and Readiness
nodes.summary: This domain converts learner evidence into day plans, an ordered Do Now queue, syllabus and topic status, mock-test trends, readiness scores, and qualified rank outlooks. It closes the loop from observed performance to a concrete next action while keeping projections explicitly dependent on evidence and remaining exam runway.

businessRules: Plan completion is duration-weighted and one overlong block cannot conceal unfinished planned work.
Readiness combines evidence-tempered coverage, retention, calibration, and open mistake surface rather than raw question volume alone.
AIR bands and exam simulations are qualified projections, not guaranteed ranks, and require sufficient evidence for confidence.
crossDomainInteractions: Aggregates session, journal, PYQ, re-attempt, formula, pattern, mock, and syllabus evidence.
Supplies prioritized work and contextual study data to reminders, digests, dashboards, and Telegram commands.

nodes.name: Buddy Collaboration and Study Engagement
nodes.summary: This domain manages buddy relationships, realtime presence and chat, privacy-safe question sharing, and multi-channel study engagement. It delivers buddy messages, planner digests, and actionable study reminders through web push, Android, email, and Telegram while respecting consent, quiet hours, foreground suppression, and retry safety.

businessRules: Only active buddy members may read or write a conversation, and shared questions expose only privacy-safe snapshot fields.
Notification channels require explicit per-device consent and must honor quiet hours, snoozes, and active-chat suppression.
Interactive actions use expiring single-use tokens and delivery jobs must be idempotent and retry-aware.
crossDomainInteractions: Requires authenticated identities and active relationship membership from the access domain.
Uses planner, re-attempt, PYQ, formula, readiness, and review context to create relevant study guidance.
Shared question references can open individual PYQ or journal practice contexts.

nodes.name: Request and Review Access
nodes.summary: A prospective learner submits a privacy-safe access request, the owner reviews it, and an approval produces an invitation while a decline can send a reasoned response.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Submit the public Request Access form

nodes.name: Create Invite-Only Account
nodes.summary: An approved invite is validated against authoritative identity data before a unique username and six-digit PIN account is created and signed in.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Open the signup page with an invite token

nodes.name: Authenticate and Recover PIN
nodes.summary: Learners exchange a username and PIN for a Supabase session or use a non-enumerating email recovery path to replace a forgotten PIN.

nodes.name: Run Focused Study Session
nodes.summary: A learner configures a session, solves timed questions, tags structured evidence, persists local-first records, and reviews the completed session.

nodes.name: Capture and Log Question
nodes.summary: A learner quickly captures or edits a standalone question, records outcome evidence, persists it, and creates due re-attempt work when required.

nodes.name: Review Mistake Journal
nodes.summary: The learner searches preserved question and session evidence, recalls concealed answers, edits diagnoses, and turns weekly patterns into one concrete fix.

nodes.name: Build Audited PYQ Catalog
nodes.summary: Repository automation ingests only allowlisted GATE-level sources, applies the canonical taxonomy, localizes assets, emits immutable shards, and audits catalog invariants.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Run the PYQ bank build command

nodes.name: Run PYQ Practice Set
nodes.summary: A learner selects an audited book and scope, starts or resumes a durable set, solves timed questions, and advances through committed and skipped items.

nodes.name: Commit and Analyze PYQ Attempt
nodes.summary: A submitted PYQ answer is graded, captured as an immutable receipt, atomically linked to canonical study history, and optionally expanded into journal analysis.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Submit a decision for the current PYQ

nodes.name: Execute Spaced Re-attempt Ladder
nodes.summary: Eligible mistakes are scheduled at D3, surfaced when due, re-solved without premature answer exposure, and advanced or rescheduled from fresh evidence.

nodes.name: Practice Formulas and Triggers
nodes.summary: Learners review due formulas and timed trigger phrases, explicitly judge recall, and persist the next review state and response-speed evidence.

nodes.name: Assemble Weekly Revision Pack
nodes.summary: The latest weekly constraint, due retrieval work, slow triggers, recurring mistakes, and priority questions are combined into one focused, copyable revision checklist.

nodes.name: Plan and Execute Study Day
nodes.summary: A learner creates subject and mode blocks for a calendar day, mirrors the plan, launches work from a block, and reconciles actual execution back into duration-weighted completion.

nodes.name: Build Do Now Queue
nodes.summary: Live due, unresolved, uncertain, slow, formula, and planned-work evidence is ranked into an actionable queue whose first item routes directly into execution.

nodes.name: Calculate Readiness and Rank Outlook
nodes.summary: HETU combines evidence-tempered coverage, retention, calibration, and mistake surface into readiness, tracks movement, recommends next moves, and presents qualified AIR and exam-day projections.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Open Readiness or run the weekly readiness job

nodes.name: Track Mocks and Topic Mastery
nodes.summary: Mock results and per-topic PYQ, journal, re-attempt, recency, and manual study evidence are persisted and combined to recommend the next unfinished or weak topic.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Record a mock or open Syllabus Tracker

nodes.name: Manage Buddy Relationship
nodes.summary: An authenticated learner requests a buddy by username, the peer accepts or declines, and the workspace maintains active, outgoing, incoming, and paused relationship states.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Create or act on a Buddy request

nodes.name: Chat and Share Questions
nodes.summary: Active buddies establish presence, exchange realtime messages, share privacy-safe question snapshots, and reconcile optimistic, delivered, read, and typing state.

nodes.name: Deliver Buddy Notifications
nodes.summary: New buddy messages enqueue idempotent delivery jobs that apply privacy, consent, snooze, and foreground rules before web or Android push and interactive actions are delivered.

nodes.name: Deliver Study Reminders and Digests
nodes.summary: User-local schedules select due learners, assemble planner and practice context, and deliver consented reminders or digests through push, email, and Telegram with durable event outcomes.

nodes.name: Validate Public Request
nodes.summary: Collect applicant identity and purpose, reject invalid input, and use a honeypot to deter automated submissions.

nodes.name: Submit Edge Request
nodes.summary: Send the normalized public request with anonymous credentials and normalize transport or service errors.

nodes.name: Store Rate-Limited Request
nodes.summary: Validate fields again, rate-limit submissions, persist without exposing existing accounts, and notify the owner.

nodes.name: Review Owner Queue
nodes.summary: Load account requests by status and present approval, decline, reason, and invite recovery actions to the owner.

nodes.name: Approve and Issue Invite
nodes.summary: Authorize the owner decision, create an invitation, and return its email delivery status for recovery or copying.

nodes.name: Collect Signup Details
nodes.summary: Hydrate the invite-backed form, derive a username suggestion, and validate identity and matching PINs.

nodes.name: Check Username Availability
nodes.summary: Perform a non-authoritative username availability preflight while preserving server-side signup as the final decision.

nodes.name: Submit Invite Signup
nodes.summary: Send the invite token, identity, username, and PIN to the public signup function and validate its response.

nodes.name: Bind Authoritative Identity
nodes.summary: Load the invite and original account request together so signup cannot pivot to another email or identity.

nodes.name: Create and Sign In Account
nodes.summary: Atomically redeem the invite, create the PIN account, and establish the learner session used by protected routes.

nodes.name: Validate Login Form
nodes.summary: Accept a normalized username and six-digit PIN and present deferred, uniform authentication feedback.

nodes.name: Exchange Credentials
nodes.summary: Exchange username and PIN for Supabase session tokens through the authentication Edge Function.

nodes.name: Request Private Recovery
nodes.summary: Collect a username and show the same sent state regardless of whether an account can be recovered.

nodes.name: Send Recovery Email
nodes.summary: Ask the recovery function to generate and email a reset link without exposing account existence.

nodes.name: Replace PIN and Sign Out
nodes.summary: Validate the recovery session and matching PINs, update the credential, then sign out before returning to login.

nodes.name: Configure Session
nodes.summary: Choose subject, target duration, and question count, optionally link a planner block, and persist the new session.

nodes.name: Solve with Timers
nodes.summary: Run question and session timers, preserve reload-safe progress, and record interruptions while the learner solves.

nodes.name: Tag Learning Evidence
nodes.summary: Capture source, outcome, pattern, trigger, and conditional root-cause evidence through the tagging state machine.

nodes.name: Persist Question and Session
nodes.summary: Write related question, session, pattern, and re-attempt changes atomically to local-first storage and queue synchronization.

nodes.name: Review Session Outcomes
nodes.summary: Aggregate timing, outcomes, patterns, questions, and insight and allow safe edits after completion.

nodes.name: Capture Compressed Image
nodes.summary: Read, resize, compress, and size-check a question image for bounded offline persistence.

nodes.name: Collect Minimum Evidence
nodes.summary: Capture the standalone question, outcome, mistake information, and other minimum fields needed for useful review.

nodes.name: Normalize Question Draft
nodes.summary: Convert the edited draft into a canonical persisted question row while retaining identity and timestamps.

nodes.name: Schedule Required Re-attempt
nodes.summary: Idempotently create the first open D3 record when the captured outcome requires retrieval practice.

nodes.name: Surface in Journal
nodes.summary: Make the standalone evidence searchable and editable alongside session and PYQ history.

nodes.name: Load and Filter Evidence
nodes.summary: Load questions, sessions, and PYQ receipts and apply URL-aware filters, search, and pagination.

nodes.name: Inspect Diagnosed Entry
nodes.summary: Expand a row to inspect source, outcome, timing, root cause, image, and analysis details.

nodes.name: Recall Concealed Answer
nodes.summary: Keep the saved answer hidden until the learner explicitly reveals it or chooses to add missing answer evidence.

nodes.name: Edit Question Diagnosis
nodes.summary: Update source, answer, timing, outcome, pattern, trigger, and root-cause evidence without changing record identity.

nodes.name: Commit Weekly Fix
nodes.summary: Summarize the week's evidence, name the root cause and weakest concept, and persist one concrete corrective action.

nodes.name: Ingest Allowlisted Sources
nodes.summary: Load only explicitly admitted GATE-level sources and reject count, provenance, or answer-key drift.

nodes.name: Classify Canonical Taxonomy
nodes.summary: Apply locked corrections, source-scope hints, and subject-specific rules to assign canonical subjects and topics.

nodes.name: Localize Question Assets
nodes.summary: Download, validate, hash, and rewrite question images into immutable local bank paths.

nodes.name: Emit Versioned Bank
nodes.summary: Write subject shards, book aggregates, manifest, audit metadata, and provenance for runtime loading.

nodes.name: Audit Bank Invariants
nodes.summary: Verify stable IDs, exact global and per-book counts, five admitted books, taxonomy stability, and locked classifications.

nodes.name: Configure Book and Scope
nodes.summary: Choose book, subject, topic, year, type, history, order, and count while resetting invalid dependent filters.

nodes.name: Load Catalog and Questions
nodes.summary: Load the versioned manifest and cached subject shards, then apply book and topic scope.

nodes.name: Create Durable Set
nodes.summary: Persist the ordered question UIDs, filter configuration, timing anchors, and initial progress for safe resume.

nodes.name: Start Timed Question
nodes.summary: Move the session cursor to a valid question and start its timing window without losing prior progress.

nodes.name: Capture Answer and Decision
nodes.summary: Collect MCQ, MSQ, or NAT input and require an explicit mark, skip, or uncertainty decision before commit.

nodes.name: Grade Submitted Answer
nodes.summary: Evaluate MCQ, MSQ, or tolerance-aware NAT input while preserving skipped and unavailable-key states.

nodes.name: Create Immutable Receipt
nodes.summary: Validate session and bank invariants and capture timing, answers, decision, screenshot, book, and exact question snapshot.

nodes.name: Persist Atomic History
nodes.summary: Write the attempt, canonical journal question, session projection, and related records as one local-first batch.

nodes.name: Advance Session Progress
nodes.summary: Mark the committed question complete, accumulate elapsed time, and advance idempotently to the next item.

nodes.name: Expand Journal Analysis
nodes.summary: Seed a journal draft from the receipt and collect pattern, trigger, and root-cause evidence without altering the attempt facts.

nodes.name: Classify Retrieval Need
nodes.summary: Map answer decision, correctness, and pace into the outcome used by mistake analysis and re-attempt policy.

nodes.name: Schedule D3 Card
nodes.summary: Create one idempotent open re-attempt with its initial D3 due date.

nodes.name: Build Due Queue
nodes.summary: Partition re-attempts into due, upcoming, and mastered groups without rewriting overdue dates.

nodes.name: Run Fresh Retrieval
nodes.summary: Restore logged or immutable PYQ evidence, conceal answers, time the attempt, and collect a fresh response.

nodes.name: Advance or Reschedule
nodes.summary: Persist the result history and move the card toward D10, D30, or mastery, or return it to the prior stage after failure.

nodes.name: Load Due Formulas
nodes.summary: Load the subject-grouped formula library and identify formulas whose spaced review is due.

nodes.name: Judge Formula Recall
nodes.summary: Let the learner mark each due formula recalled or forgotten and inspect its prior review history.

nodes.name: Load Trigger Drill
nodes.summary: Order personalized question phrases and methods for a timed reflex drill.

nodes.name: Time and Judge Trigger
nodes.summary: Normalize a recalled method or request a manual judgment and capture response duration.

nodes.name: Persist Retrieval State
nodes.summary: Update formula scheduling, forgotten counts, trigger attempts, and average response speed for future prioritization.

nodes.name: Load Current Weekly Fix
nodes.summary: Use the latest completed weekly review's concrete correction as the pack's current constraint.

nodes.name: Collect Due Retrieval Evidence
nodes.summary: Gather due formulas, slow triggers, repeated patterns, and due or recent mistake questions.

nodes.name: Prioritize Pack Items
nodes.summary: Order the weekly fix and retrieval work so the most actionable unresolved evidence appears first.

nodes.name: Render Grouped Pack
nodes.summary: Display the current constraint and grouped formula, trigger, mistake, and question lists with counts.

nodes.name: Copy Study Checklist
nodes.summary: Serialize the pack into a structured plain-text checklist for use outside the screen.

nodes.name: Select Calendar Day
nodes.summary: Navigate a stable six-week calendar and select a valid day with existing duration and subject summaries.

nodes.name: Edit Study Blocks
nodes.summary: Add or update subject, duration, mode, priority, target, and resource fields and maintain the day's review.

nodes.name: Persist Local and Cloud Plan
nodes.summary: Save the user-scoped day locally and debounce a validated session mirror to Supabase with conflict resolution.

nodes.name: Launch Linked Work
nodes.summary: Route the selected block into PYQ, mock, resumed, or new focused-session work and mark it started.

nodes.name: Reconcile Actual Completion
nodes.summary: Join completed sessions and mock tests back to their exact blocks and recompute duration-weighted day completion.

nodes.name: Reduce Latest Attempts
nodes.summary: Select the latest receipt per PYQ so queue decisions reflect current evidence rather than duplicate history.

nodes.name: Rank Actionable Work
nodes.summary: Prioritize due re-attempts, unanalyzed or uncertain PYQs, slow correct work, formula reviews, and unfinished planner blocks.

nodes.name: Reconcile and Display Queue
nodes.summary: Combine live Dexie evidence with today's plan, reconcile completed work, and present the highest-value next action.

nodes.name: Start Selected Action
nodes.summary: Mark a linked planner block started when applicable and route the learner into the working flow.

nodes.name: Compute Core Readiness
nodes.summary: Combine sample-tempered coverage, retention, calibration, and open mistake surface into a score and confidence level.

nodes.name: Calculate Subject Breakdown
nodes.summary: Join re-attempt and question evidence, scale subject coverage targets, and calculate readiness by subject.

nodes.name: Store Trend and Debt
nodes.summary: Upsert the daily snapshot, compare prior weeks, and retain weak components that remain below threshold.

nodes.name: Project Rank and Exam Marks
nodes.summary: Map readiness and runway to a caveated AIR band and run a deterministic Monte Carlo marks simulation.

nodes.name: Present Next Moves
nodes.summary: Render score components, trend, subject matrix, prioritized actions, peer context, and explicitly qualified projections.

nodes.name: Validate Mock Result
nodes.summary: Validate mock identity, date, totals, duration, score bounds, and internally consistent answer counts.

nodes.name: Persist Mock and Trends
nodes.summary: Store mock scores, accuracy, mistakes, subject marks, history trends, and linked planner completion.

nodes.name: Build Topic Evidence
nodes.summary: Combine PYQ attempts, journal questions, open re-attempts, study state, accuracy, and recency without double counting.

nodes.name: Synchronize Topic Progress
nodes.summary: Merge user-scoped manual completions with Dexie and delayed cloud rows while migrating legacy records idempotently.

nodes.name: Recommend Next Topic
nodes.summary: Present syllabus completion with practice evidence and select the next unfinished topic from active or untouched subjects.

nodes.name: Submit Buddy Request
nodes.summary: Send an authenticated username request and preserve the server status for creation, cooldown, or rejection.

nodes.name: Create Private Request
nodes.summary: Create the request through a protected database workflow and send best-effort notification without exposing account existence.

nodes.name: Act on Request
nodes.summary: Let recipients accept or decline, requesters cancel, and paused peers request again when cooldown allows.

nodes.name: Refresh Relationship Workspace
nodes.summary: Reload relationships and previews and reconcile active, incoming, outgoing, and paused states through realtime updates.

nodes.name: Establish Pair Presence
nodes.summary: Create one presence channel per active buddy and synchronize online peer IDs as visibility changes.

nodes.name: Load and Subscribe Conversation
nodes.summary: Load paginated messages and subscribe to chat, typing, read, and relationship changes for the selected buddy.

nodes.name: Project Safe Question Reference
nodes.summary: Reduce a selected question to the privacy-safe fields permitted in a shared buddy message.

nodes.name: Send and Merge Message
nodes.summary: Insert an optimistic text or question message and deduplicate it against realtime delivery in chronological order.

nodes.name: Render Delivery and Read State
nodes.summary: Display grouped messages with sender alignment, timestamps, delivery state, shared-question details, and read behavior.

nodes.name: Enqueue Outbox Job
nodes.summary: Create a transactional notification job when a buddy message is committed so delivery can be claimed idempotently.

nodes.name: Load Job and Subscriptions
nodes.summary: Load the message and recipient devices, record delivery rows, and apply active-chat, snooze, and consent rules.

nodes.name: Issue Secure Actions
nodes.summary: Create expiring action and inline-reply tokens and attach only platform-supported actions to the notification.

nodes.name: Dispatch Web or Native Push
nodes.summary: Normalize copy and deliver through browser Web Push or Android FCM while classifying permanent provider failures.

nodes.name: Execute Interactive Action
nodes.summary: Render the native notification and use durable WorkManager delivery for inline replies or bounded authenticated actions.

nodes.name: Configure Consent and Schedule
nodes.summary: Persist separate notification consent, category enablement, timezone, and minute-level local delivery schedules.

nodes.name: Select Due Local Time
nodes.summary: Convert the invocation time into each learner's local clock and decide whether the configured schedule is inside its grace window.

nodes.name: Load Current Study Context
nodes.summary: Load planner, attempts, questions, formulas, patterns, readiness, reviews, and due work required for contextual guidance.

nodes.name: Build Actionable Copy
nodes.summary: Compose category-specific reminder or daily digest content with safe routes, concise plan details, and motivational context.

nodes.name: Deliver, Record, and Retry
nodes.summary: Send through enabled push, email, or Telegram channels, persist outcomes, and retry reminders whose delay has elapsed.

edges.description: Authenticated identity scopes every session, question, pattern, and journal record and controls protected study routes.
Learner identity owns durable PYQ sessions and immutable attempt receipts.
Approved accounts and authenticated membership gate buddy relationships, chat access, subscriptions, and delivery actions.
Each committed PYQ attempt can create a canonical journal question for pattern, trigger, and root-cause analysis.
Incorrect, uncertain, slow, or skipped PYQ receipts become reconstructable spaced re-attempt work.
Diagnosed non-clean outcomes, formulas, trigger phrases, and weekly fixes supply retrieval and revision work.
Session volume, outcomes, patterns, timing, calibration decisions, and weekly review evidence feed plans and readiness.
Due work, retention, mastery, formula reviews, and open mistake surface shape the Do Now queue and readiness score.
Plans, due work, readiness, mocks, formulas, and reviews provide the context for reminders, digests, and Telegram study commands.
Privacy-safe shared question references let buddies navigate back into the relevant practice evidence without sharing private analysis fields.
